I wrote the report with `verdict: fix`. The status rail still isn't one line, and the first grid row is too low.

- **Status rail:** at 1200 it takes four lines, and at 400 it runs off the right edge and sits over the last rows. Ask 2 wants one line.
- **First row:** "Ultracode" sits at about y 290 of 900, roughly 32% down. The task wants the first row in the top ~25%.
- **Missing measurements:** the four auto-picked shot pages are not the Sessions page, and `shots/sessions/` has no `layout.json`. The task dir also has no before/after numbers (first-row y, footer height, left padding). So sizing and spacing answers rest on the PNGs alone. I did not open the 1920 or 3440 shots.
- **The diff:** it is one CSS block in `sessions.css` plus `files.jsonl` / `page.jsonl` noise. It adds no breadcrumb, left rail or routes, so asks 3 and 4 can't be judged against it. The shots do show both a year/month breadcrumb and a left rail at 1200. At 400 the rail collapses into a wrapped chip row.

I made no code edits.

The report is at `public/framework/ai/sessions/2026/10/13/session-730e8a7b/mastermind-repo-slim/sessions-page-layout/review/report.md`.
